verdict.rationale: Capacities documents some of its own multi-item operations: a Bulk Import flow for migrating many items at once, a full export that can be scheduled, and an AI assistant that can plan multi-step work and propose creates and updates for approval. None of this is documented as general bulk editing, such as multi-select retagging, property changes or deletes across many objects. The REST API and MCP are developer building blocks, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented in-app bulk edit/delete/tag across selected items, explicit AI batch updates across many objects, hands-on corroboration.
